Carter, they called him King, the King, because -- I'll tell you a little story about this. I had never heard nobody in the world playing alto saxiphone like Benny Carter, and he had such a beautiful, beautiful, fluid, flowing style. And so one day, you know, like when Billy Eckstine was trying to tell me about Charlie Parker before I really knew who Charlie Parker was, Billy said, man, this cat --and he used Benny Carter 25 a, uh -- he said, this cat plays more than Benny Carter, because he couldn't think of…
